intro: Maltese is the only Semitic language that is an official language of the EU, and Malta is one of Europe's most Catholic countries.

chapters.title: Language and faith
text: Maltese grew from Arabic but is written in the Latin alphabet and borrows many words from Italian and English; English is also an official language. Most Maltese are Catholic, and each village holds a festa for its patron saint, with processions, brass bands and fireworks.

chapters.title: Island life
text: Valletta is the capital, but many towns run together on the crowded main island. Many newcomers from other EU countries and beyond now live and work in Malta.

keyTerms.meaning: A language family that includes Arabic, Hebrew and Maltese.
